items.text: Make the toilet flush, and make sure it isn't running.
items.priceBasis: Est. 45 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $27. Diagnose, then swap flapper and/or fill valve, test. Material $25 for flapper/fill valve.

items.text: Remove the boards off both windows. Make at least one window open, stay open, close, and lock.
items.priceBasis: Est. 60 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $36. Unboard two windows, then free the sash, adjust, and get one locking.

items.text: Screw shut the other window if it can't be made to work.
items.priceBasis: Est. 10 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $6. A few screws once the call is made. Material $10 for screws.

items.text: Remove the blinds from both windows — they're broken.
items.priceBasis: Est. 15 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $9. Unscrew and pull two sets of brackets.

items.text: Make the window on the driveway side open, stay open, close, and lock.
items.priceBasis: Est. 40 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $24. Free one stuck sash, adjust the balance, confirm it holds and locks.

items.text: Make at least two of the three living room windows open, stay open, close, and lock.
items.priceBasis: Est. 80 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $48. Two windows at ~40 min each.

items.text: Install a bulb in the pull chain light fixture close to the furnace, or replace the fixture to make it work.
Secure both exhaust vents going into the chimney and seal any gaps with mortar — no potential for a leak.
items.priceBasis: Est. 90 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $54. Mix mortar, pack and tool two penetrations, secure both pipes, clean up.

items.text: Put a blank cover on the open junction box next to the furnace.
items.priceBasis: Est. 10 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $6. Fit and screw on one blank cover. Material $10 for one blank cover.

items.text: Put the loose hanging wires where they join the furnace into a box, and remove any loose hanging cable wires.
items.priceBasis: Est. 60 min at $35.71/hr ($250 per 7-hour day) = $36. Mount a box, land the wires, secure the run, pull the abandoned cable. Material $25 for a box and connectors.

items.text: Get windows operating — open, stay open, close, lock — in three rooms: upper left bedroom (1 of 2), upper right bedroom (driveway side), living room (2 of 3).

questions.text: Did I put the keys back?
